OfficePdf portable mode

While this file sits next to office-pdf.exe, OfficePdf keeps its settings, log files, crash-recovery
autosaves and new digital IDs in the OfficePdfData folder beside it, and writes nothing to
%APPDATA% or %LOCALAPPDATA%. Copy the whole folder to move OfficePdf with its settings.

Delete this file to use the normal per-user folders (%APPDATA%\OfficePdf and
%LOCALAPPDATA%\OfficePdf) instead. If OfficePdfData can't be written (for example on a read-only
drive), OfficePdf says so and uses the per-user folders instead.
